title: Fix 5 CodeQL alerts: ReDoS + workflow permissions
description:
GitHub code scanning reports 5 open alerts (all 'warning'; ReDoS ones are security-severity high):

1. packages/core/src/orchestrator/dice.ts:30 — DICE_RE has adjacent \s* groups + trailing \s*$, classic polynomial ReDoS on model-supplied dice notation.
2. packages/core/src/orchestrator/protocol.ts:13 — TOOL_CALL_FENCE has \s*\n where \s matches \n, then lazy [\s\S]*?\n?, polynomial on model output.
3. packages/cli/src/registry.ts:131 — slugify uses /^-+|-+$/g, the canonical CodeQL BAD example. Input is trusted CLI name; trivial harden.
4. packages/core/src/persistence/checkpoint/separation.ts:30 — normalizeRemoteUrl uses /\/+$/. Trusted local config input; trivial harden.
5. .github/workflows/ci.yml:49 — workflow has no permissions block; add top-level contents: read.

Fix all on one feature branch + PR. No behavior change expected; existing tests must keep passing.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 CodeQL alerts close after merge; npm run typecheck and npm run test pass; PR open against main.
notes: PR open: https://github.com/jbongaarts/loreweaver/pull/62 — close after merge + CodeQL re-scan confirms alerts #1–#5 resolved.
close_reason: Merged via PR #62; all 5 CodeQL alerts addressed.
